description: Full profile for one token: price, market cap, FDV, volume, supply, ATH, links, categories, contract addresses per chain, top DEX liquidity pools, and for Base tokens the launchpad that deployed it (coinfactory, clanker or zora; detected on-chain). Accepts a CoinGecko id (e.g. 'bitcoin'), a symbol, a name, or a contract address.
